methodology: Recovery of preexisting preliminary screening only. No new verse screening, independent primary-text collation, manuscript dating verification, or public promotion. Five candidate associations over four verses; the Genesis and Exodus passages share a six-day creation tradition and are not independent evidence of borrowing. Source citations are leads, not checked primary-source references.

records.topic: Those who treated religion as diversion; forgetting the encounter

candidates.relation: motif of forgetting God and consequent judgment
candidates.shared: Broad thematic or narrative resemblance only; not an established textual borrowing
candidates.different: Isaiah addresses those who forsake YHWH and neglect the holy mountain; Qur'an addresses rejection of a final encounter and signs
